description: Empirical power lookup vs significant wave height Hs. Overtopped water drives low-head turbines: P = J(Hs,Te)*ramp_width*eta_ramp*eta_turbine*eta_generator, J=(rho*g^2/64pi)*Hs^2*Te. Capped at rated power.

eta_ramp.note: Fraction of incident wave power captured as overtopping

Te_ref_s.note: Representative energy period for the lookup

P_rated_kw.note: Rated electrical power (curve clipped at rating)

power_kw.note: Electrical power at Te=9 s, clipped at 210 kW rated

source: Kofoed et al. (2006) Coastal Eng. 53:859-867; Wave Dragon device data; reuses EC136 F1a parameters
